answer: An identity bond that decays like a dune in the wind blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 200 POA bond, hard as basalt, before it can earn; the bond loses 5% per epoch unless topped up. An attacker with 100 fake identities must lock 20,000 POA and refill 1,000 POA per epoch, 20,000 POA over 20 epochs, to stay eligible. An honest agent wanders with a single bond, pays one small top-up per epoch, and keeps its full share undiluted.
